items.title: M0 red/status: prove Cell 03 launch is blocked before this story
items.context: Capture the current checker/status evidence that Cell 03 is planning-only and required launch metadata is absent.

happy.desc: Baseline checker identifies Cell 03 as next but not execution-authorized.

edge.desc: Cell 06 remains blocked in the same baseline.

adversarial.desc: Host labels and missing budget cannot clear the launch gate.

items.userSees: Baseline evidence shows: nextPermittedFormalStep=cell-03-calibration, provider execution remains disabled, and cell-06-a2prime-blocked.

items.title: M1 add Cell 03 launch authorization artifact
items.context: Create a structured Cell 03-only launch authorization packet that requires exact human-approved amount, currency, and approval source for any nonzero budget cap, plus dated snapshots, prompt/tool digests, runner ownership, duplicate policy, and an explicit no-provider-call boundary when exact budget approval is absent.

happy.desc: Cell 03 launch metadata is complete and traceable to this story, and budget approval is either exactly bound to human-approved amount/currency/source or explicitly marked absent.

edge.desc: Authorization applies only to Cell 03 E2 A4 same-family calibration.

adversarial.desc: The artifact does not invent spend approval and does not authorize Cell 06, result rows, provider fallback, or model/paper claims.

items.title: M2 harden checker and negative controls
items.context: Extend local checker coverage to accept the Cell 03 launch authorization guardrail while rejecting host-label snapshots, zero or invented budget approval, missing digests, duplicate runner ownership, provider fallback, outcome rows, and premature Cell 06 unblocking.

happy.desc: Checker reports Cell 03 launch guardrail status and Cell 06 blocked.

edge.desc: Optional Cell 04 and Cell 02 remain outside this story.

adversarial.desc: Injected malformed authorizations, including invented or unbound budget caps, fail closed.

items.title: M3 update milestone/status docs
items.context: Update README, M2 status, and provider execution plan so future agents know what is done, what remains blocked, and that no provider calls or outcome rows were produced.

happy.desc: Status ledger distinguishes Done, In Progress, Pending, and Blocked states.

edge.desc: Documentation states Cell 03 authorization is not outcome evidence.

adversarial.desc: Docs do not imply H-M1/H-M3, model-agnostic claims, or runtime/product gate changes.

items.title: M4 run local validation only
items.context: Run the M2 checker and relevant local tests without invoking provider APIs or creating result rows.

happy.desc: Local checker passes and prints the expected Cell 03/Cell 06 status.

adversarial.desc: Validation fails if provider outcome data appears.

items.title: M5 complete Lattice review, validate, and DONE
items.context: Move through review, validate, summary, delivery check, and DONE merge without touching unrelated Tier-C active work.

happy.desc: Story reaches DONE with signed validation evidence.

edge.desc: Unrelated dirty Tier-C docs remain untouched.

adversarial.desc: DONE does not claim provider execution or outcome rows.
